title: Kapalua Airport emergency night operations zoning
summary: The committee deferred the Kapalua Airport zoning change for emergency airstrip operations on March 11. The chair said both sides will keep talking and hope to reach first reading again, and the item can move forward if the state signs the county's first unilateral agreement. The state says the county would pay for the lights and it will discuss amendments, while the county calls the state's changes beyond its scope.
